free_tier.stated: no free tier: pay-as-you-go GPU instances, prices before tax. One GPU per hour: L4 (L4-1-24G, 8 vCPUs, 48 GB RAM) EUR 0.79, about EUR 574.87 per month; L40S (L40S-1-48G, 8 vCPUs, 96 GB RAM) EUR 1.47, about EUR 1,073.01 per month; H100 PCIe (H100-1-80G, 24 vCPUs, 240 GB RAM) EUR 2.87, about EUR 2,092.54 per month. L4 reaches EUR 6.3 per hour at 8 GPUs, about EUR 4,599 per month; H100 SXM starts at 2 GPUs, EUR 6.62 per hour. Billed by the minute. The page lists no A100 and no RTX4090.
